title: The post-scarcity lineage convergence
statement: The corpus reads a century and a half of terrestrial post-scarcity thought — land-rent reformers, utopian novelists, automation economists, post-work philosophers, and their contemporary heirs — as a single intellectual family whose direction of travel converges with the canon's economic proposals (woh-claim-0033, woh-claim-0049); the convergence is registered as reception context at inferred grade, with no causation in either direction and no enrollment of the family's members.

includes: The family reading: the lineage traced as one file at the Explainer's strength, from the land line through automation economics to the contemporary post-work heirs

The convergence registration: the family's direction and the canon's proposals aligned as convergence, in the same discipline as woh-claim-0042 — availability of the idea in terrestrial thought, never validation of the proposals
The movement's own systematizations (the cyberparadism stream) as the corpus-adjacent end of the family, kept distinct from the canon's statements per woh-claim-0033's vocabulary rule
excludes: Causation in either direction (the canon did not source the family; the family does not confirm the canon)
Enrollment: the family's members hold their own positions, none of them the framework's
Endorsement of the proposals, which remains excluded by the normative records themselves

source_references.locator: The home-world economy the proposals rest on (via woh-claim-0033)
A contemporary end of the family the Explainer reads
The movement-adjacent systematization, kept distinct from the canon per woh-claim-0033

alternatives.statement: The 'single file' is the corpus's construction; the thinkers' aims, mechanisms, and politics diverge more than the family reading admits.
Abundance-wishing is ancient and universal; convergence with it is too cheap to register anything.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0033 or woh-claim-0049 is revised or retired.
Case-level review shows a load-bearing member of the family mischaracterized.
Public prose begins asserting causation, enrollment, or endorsement, all of which this record excludes.
